title: fb.journey/1 — the node tree that drives the Control Tower's store journey
description: Two layers. (1) The graph: what assets/journey/engine.js validates and walks; it knows no business. (2) node.payload: opaque to the engine; the Control Tower (assets/ct/journey-view.js, screens/control-tower.js) reads the fields in $defs/towerPayload. Rules JSON Schema cannot express, which FBJourney.validate() also enforces: node ids are unique; parent, requires[], edges[].from/to, start and every { node } condition name an existing node; parent chains don't loop; requires (edges and node.requires, expanded through parents to their leaves) never loop. next edges may loop.

id.description: The graph's id; kept in every snapshot.

version.description: Kept in snapshots; a new version may take over an old snapshot (marks and done times kept for ids it still has).

meta.description: Free notes for people (source, facts file); never read.

doneNeedsOpen.description: true: a node can't be done before it is available. Default false: a store that already has the records jumps ahead.

start.description: Where the cursor sits when nothing is in focus. Default: the first root.

type.description: Opaque: returned as-is. The store journey uses chapter, area, stage, milestone; the tower reads payload fields, not types.

label.description: For people; defaults to the id.

parent.description: Makes the tree. A child is never available inside a locked parent; a skipped parent skips its children.

requires.description: Node ids that must be done or skipped first. Shorthand for requires edges into this node.

done.description: When the node is done. A condition; or "children" (default for a node with children: every required child done or skipped); or "children:any". A leaf without done is done only when marked with its own id.

skip.description: True: the node and everything under it is skipped, which counts as passed for whatever it gates.

optional.description: Doesn't hold its parent's "children" rule, isn't counted in progress, takes the focus only when no required work is open.

sticky.description: Once done, stays done even if the facts later drop.

priority.description: Lower first among siblings; then listing order.

kind.description: requires gates `to` and must never loop; next only orders next()/prev() and may loop (a daily round, a rotation).

condition.description: JSON only, no code. The engine decides states in this order: skipped > done > available > locked, repeating until nothing changes, so a condition may test another node's state.

oneOf.description: That node is in that state (or one of a list).
The snapshot holds that mark (J.mark): something no record can show, e.g. "skip:purchase".

factCondition.description: The fact at a dotted path ("products.broken", "list.length") passes every operator given. A missing number never passes a comparison. "None missing" (eq 0) holds in an empty store: pair it with a count gte 1.

towerPayload.description: Opaque to the engine. These are the fields the Control Tower reads; anything else is carried through untouched. One graph drives the whole tower: assets/tower/graphs/control-tower.json.

line.description: Root node (chapter, milestone): the line under the greeting while it is the chapter.

pins.description: Root node: the two areas the footer pinned (Business tab).

mode.description: Root node: when this is the chapter, the journey is over and home is the everyday tower.

area.description: This node IS that area of the tower: an area card, an area page, a story ring and cards on Now. Known areas: products, customers, order, deliveries, collections, inventory, purchase, production.

locked.description: Area: why it is locked, shown on its card and page. Default: built from its blockers.

promise.description: Area: what it does for the owner, under the headline.

model.description: Area: its tiles are the tower's Products model (Finished Goods' own rules, assets/ct/products-area.js); each product is a row, and on Now a card.

source.description: Area: the named data source its rows come from. lever:<id> (the business's records through the tower's lever model), products (Finished Goods' rules), store-activation (what store activation saved). Unknown or empty: the area's own steps.

tiles.description: Area: the page's On track / Needs work / Urgent tiles from facts. Without tiles or a model, the tiles count the area's steps (Done · To do).

announce.description: A one-line moment when the node reaches that state (shown once).

title.description: Step: the step in a few words; {n} is replaced by the fact in count and left out at zero ("Fix {n} products"). Also what Now's coin burst says, in the past tense ("Products added").

coins.description: Step: what finishing it puts in the wallet. Paid once, on node.done, only when facts prove it. Shown on the card's button with the card's own +10.

ask.description: Step: the headline of its page and its sheet's title.

how.description: Step: the line under it (What to do).

count.description: Step: a fact path; its value is {n} in say and title.

say.description: Step: the progress line, with {n} ("{n} hidden from customers").

action.description: Step: the button's words (Now's card, the step's sheet, an empty area's one way in).

cheer.description: Step: what the assistant says over it.

flow.description: Step: the button opens this module's own modal over the tower (Now opens it straight away).

screen.description: Step: else the button opens this platform screen, after an inline ask.

demo.description: Step, new-store demo only: a quiet link on the card that merges these facts into the store's demo facts.

view.description: Tab: which of the tower's views it opens.

home.description: Tab: the one the tower opens on.

icon.description: Tab or area: a name from the tower's icon set (now, tower, coin, more, truck, rupee, clip, box, cart, factory, tag, users).

word.description: Area: its everyday word, on its ring and cards ("Buying").

colour.description: Area: its cards' gradient (deep to bright) and its ring's tint.

rank.description: Area: what closes first. On Now, Urgent before Needs work, then lower rank, then the bigger figure.

feed.description: Area: how its rows become cards on Now. App node: oneCardPer (row kinds that are one card whatever their step) and minGroup.

groups.description: What alike rows share (the step, tag:<incident>, fam:<family>, alert, tab:<tab>) → the group card's line; {n} is how many, {sum} their money.

kickers.description: Same keys → what happened, in a few words, over a card with no incident.

families.description: Incident → family, so a thing's next problem in the same family stays one card.

line.description: Area card's line on Business when something needs the owner: {n} needs, {n|word} pluralised, {owed} money owed; **…** is bold.

open.description: Area: its rows open this way instead of their own card: ask in place, then go to the route ({field} from the row).

text.description: App node: how names are written on cards. keepUpper, units, drop (patterns removed from names), codes (patterns of codes never shown).
